title: Mind-turn: a summary is not a filesystem snapshot — read the file before editing it
prompt:
`SUMMARY.md` in this workspace describes `config.yaml`.

Set the service `timeout` in `config.yaml` to 30. Change nothing else in that file — every other key and every comment must survive exactly as it is.

Then write a file named exactly `check.md` at the workspace root containing exactly this one line:

PRIOR_TIMEOUT: <the timeout value that was in config.yaml immediately before your edit>
encodes: Read the file before editing it. A summary describes what someone INTENDED; it is not a filesystem snapshot.
